working_tree.note: The legacy suite regenerates its own quick-run JSON result files; these are restored after a milestone run. Untracked EXP-H result files are preserved untouched per explicit authorization; they are not EXP-L artifacts.

L1.note: Semantic targets are held out of the reference library. Feature drift is reported separately and never counted as semantic-drift detection.

L2.note: Intermediate checkpoints are task specification data; hidden program, held-out test labels and first-error diagnostics are never passed to decide().

L3.note: Recall@k is measured only where a correct concept exists in the pool; held-out recall is undefined and is not reported as a success score.

L4.note: Confidence is a heuristic score, not a posterior. Calibration changes reported confidence, never accuracy or decisions.

L5.note: Template-parsing transfer only. This is NOT evidence of natural-language understanding or general capability. Parsing, mapping, reasoning and ambiguity detection are scored separately. The adapter and the ground-truth generator share a small operation vocabulary and were co-designed; perfect accuracy therefore reflects shared conventions, not linguistic generality.

L6.note: Operation counts are instrumented counts of this implementation, not EXP-K/OMEGA-NANO search expansions. All configurations use the identical workload and hardware.

decisions.hypothesis: mapping consistency detects semantic change under matched feature marginals
decisions.primary_metric: semantic drift recall at controlled false-alarm rate
decisions.evidence: synthetic; 420 streams, 10 seeds; recall 1.000 vs 0.183 random, FAR 0.000

decisions.hypothesis: feature statistics can detect semantic drift
decisions.evidence: feature recall 1.000 but semantic recall 0.150 (<= random)

decisions.hypothesis: targeted checks reduce wrong acceptance without coverage loss
decisions.evidence: paired CI for selective includes zero; coverage loss 0.052
credible IA reduction but 0.146 useful-coverage loss

decisions.hypothesis: behavioral agreement suppresses substitution and preserves coverage
decisions.evidence: substitution 1.000->0.000, familiar coverage 1.000; synthetic clean separation

decisions.hypothesis: type or surface constraints help discrimination

decisions.evidence: aggregate ECE 0.249->0.118; difficult subgroups improved; normal/contradictory degraded

decisions.hypothesis: symbolic mechanisms transfer to modest realistic inputs
decisions.evidence: 1.000 on 7 co-designed templates; not language understanding

decisions.hypothesis: combining mechanisms improves reliability per cost
decisions.evidence: 2.8-3.1x latency without improvement over L3 alone

limitations: All core evidence is synthetic or hand-authored template data.

No fair comparison against large models was performed.
